incoming_learnings: An unresolved pool objective needs an executable preparation transaction, not merely a descent veto. Remote awareness visibility and missing chest objects must not be treated as collection evidence. Preserve unknown-potion, storage, habitat and protection-funded return checks.

review.review: The hero remained alive at full health when mandatory potion preparation exhausted (decision 780, log lines 2258–2259). The initiating contradiction was a false flight reservation: a revealed confusion trap at 543 was associated with gold at 512, although an observed trap-free dry approach exists around aquarium 545. Fish-bank exclusion, not that trap, made the gold unreachable. Decision 692 spent a puzzle-backed meal; decision 693 reported no protected flight round trip. The separate pool chest had already yielded a sword. Offline reconstruction matched all 780 original actions and reasons and reproduced the terminal blocker. The proposed correction excludes positively observed ground-connected aquarium-ring rewards from this flight inference without admitting movement or crediting collection. Four new regression tests fail as expected on original policy and pass on the candidate; the full suite passes 2,264 tests with four skipped. An isolated terminal probe selects bank reobservation, not drinking or descent. This does not establish eventual identification, collection or survival.
review.learnings: Distinguish fish-blocked aquarium banks from rewards that actually require flight. Known dry connectivity can disprove a flight prerequisite without making the bank safe. Keep aquarium loot unfinished, preserve mandatory pickups and require fresh preparation and protection checks before execution.

recommendations.summary: Prevent nearby traps from creating false flight prerequisites for ground-connected aquarium-bank loot.
